title: Polynomial bound on circuit encoding length
statement: Let $C,c,a,k$ be natural numbers and let $F$ be a family of directed acyclic circuits, with the circuit in the family for inputs of length $n$ having $n$ input vertices. Suppose every circuit in $F$ is well formed with fan-in at most two, and its size is at most $a(n+1)^k$ for every $n\in\mathbb{N}$. Then for every bit string $x$, the encoding length of the circuit in $F$ for inputs of length $q(C,c,x)$, plus one, is at most $\bigl(12a^2(8+3C)^{2k}+1\bigr)(|x|+1)^{2(c+1)k}$, where $q(C,c,x)=2\bigl(2|x|+2+C(|x|+1)^c\bigr)+2+C(|x|+1)^c+1$.
hypotheses_covered: $F$ is a family of directed acyclic circuits
Every circuit in $F$ has fan-in at most two and is well formed
For every $n$, the circuit size is at most $a(n+1)^k$
